ck_purchase_invoices_kind.name: ck_purchase_invoices_kind
ck_purchase_invoices_kind.value: ("purchase_invoices"."kind" = 'invoice' AND "purchase_invoices"."original_invoice_id" IS NULL) OR ("purchase_invoices"."kind" = 'reversal' AND "purchase_invoices"."original_invoice_id" IS NOT NULL)

ck_purchase_payments_kind.name: ck_purchase_payments_kind
ck_purchase_payments_kind.value: ("purchase_payments"."kind" = 'payment' AND "purchase_payments"."original_payment_id" IS NULL) OR ("purchase_payments"."kind" = 'reversal' AND "purchase_payments"."original_payment_id" IS NOT NULL)

ck_purchase_quality_inspection_line_quan.name: ck_purchase_quality_inspection_line_quantities
ck_purchase_quality_inspection_line_quan.value:
typeof("purchase_quality_inspection_lines"."passed_qty") = 'integer' AND typeof("purchase_quality_inspection_lines"."rejected_qty") = 'integer'
      AND "purchase_quality_inspection_lines"."passed_qty" >= 0 AND "purchase_quality_inspection_lines"."rejected_qty" >= 0
      AND "purchase_quality_inspection_lines"."passed_qty" + "purchase_quality_inspection_lines"."rejected_qty" BETWEEN 1 AND 1000000

ck_purchase_quality_inspection_defect_re.name: ck_purchase_quality_inspection_defect_reason
ck_purchase_quality_inspection_defect_re.value:
("purchase_quality_inspection_lines"."rejected_qty" = 0 AND "purchase_quality_inspection_lines"."defect_reason" IS NULL)
      OR ("purchase_quality_inspection_lines"."rejected_qty" > 0 AND "purchase_quality_inspection_lines"."defect_reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("purchase_quality_inspection_lines"."defect_reason")) BETWEEN 1 AND 500)

ck_purchase_request_lines_source_fields.name: ck_purchase_request_lines_source_fields
ck_purchase_request_lines_source_fields.value:
("purchase_request_lines"."purchase_demand_id" IS NULL AND "purchase_request_lines"."source_required_quantity" IS NULL AND "purchase_request_lines"."source_updated_at" IS NULL)
    OR ("purchase_request_lines"."purchase_demand_id" IS NOT NULL AND "purchase_request_lines"."source_required_quantity" IS NOT NULL AND "purchase_request_lines"."source_updated_at" IS NOT NULL)

ck_manual_purchase_requests_note.name: ck_manual_purchase_requests_note
ck_manual_purchase_requests_note.value: "purchase_requests"."source" <> 'manual' OR ("purchase_requests"."note" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("purchase_requests"."note")) > 0)

ck_warehouse_outbound_stage.name: ck_warehouse_outbound_stage
ck_warehouse_outbound_stage.value:
("warehouse_outbound_events"."version" = 1 AND "warehouse_outbound_events"."step" = 'pick' AND typeof("warehouse_outbound_events"."quantity") = 'integer'
        AND "warehouse_outbound_events"."quantity" BETWEEN 1 AND 2147483647 AND "warehouse_outbound_events"."sku_code" IS NULL AND "warehouse_outbound_events"."package_count" IS NULL)
      OR ("warehouse_outbound_events"."version" = 2 AND "warehouse_outbound_events"."step" = 'verify' AND typeof("warehouse_outbound_events"."quantity") = 'integer'
        AND "warehouse_outbound_events"."quantity" BETWEEN 1 AND 2147483647 AND "warehouse_outbound_events"."sku_code" IS NOT NULL
        AND length(trim("warehouse_outbound_events"."sku_code")) BETWEEN 1 AND 160 AND "warehouse_outbound_events"."package_count" IS NULL)
      OR ("warehouse_outbound_events"."version" = 3 AND "warehouse_outbound_events"."step" = 'pack' AND "warehouse_outbound_events"."quantity" IS NULL AND "warehouse_outbound_events"."sku_code" IS NULL
        AND typeof("warehouse_outbound_events"."package_count") = 'integer' AND "warehouse_outbound_events"."package_count" BETWEEN 1 AND 2147483647)
